name: Coordinate reflection
conditions: Standard orthogonal Cartesian axes.

name: Distance and midpoint
conditions: Euclidean plane with equally scaled perpendicular axes.

name: Internal section formula
conditions: Internal ratio AP:PB=m:n with m,n>0.

name: Slope of a nonvertical line
conditions: Requires x₂≠x₁ for finite slope.

name: Perpendicular slope relation
conditions: Both slopes must be finite and nonzero.

name: Point–slope equation
conditions: Finite slope; vertical lines use x=c.

name: General line equation
conditions: A and B cannot both be zero.

name: Point-to-line distance
conditions: Nondegenerate line: A²+B²>0.

name: Intersection of two lines
conditions: For a unique intersection, m₁≠m₂.

name: Perpendicular-bisector locus
conditions: Equidistant from two distinct fixed points.

name: Standard circle equation
conditions: r>0 for a nondegenerate circle.

name: Tangent length to a circle
conditions: PC≥r; equality is the point of tangency.

name: Parabola focus/directrix
conditions: Standard vertex at origin; p≠0.

name: Ellipse focal relation
conditions: Ellipse with major semiaxis a and minor semiaxis b.

name: Hyperbola focal relation
conditions: Standard real hyperbola; a,b>0.

name: Conic discriminant
conditions: Standard general quadratic with A,B,C not all zero.

name: Coordinate-axis translation
conditions: Origin translated to (h,k) with axes kept parallel.

name: Polar-to-Cartesian conversion
conditions: Angle measured from +x axis; use consistent degrees or radians.

name: Parametric line
conditions: Parameter t restricted as given.

name: Vector addition
conditions: Vectors expressed in the same Cartesian basis.

name: Dot product
conditions: Components refer to the same orthonormal frame.

name: 3D distance
conditions: Orthogonal Cartesian coordinates.

name: Parametric line in space
conditions: Direction vector (a,b,c) is nonzero.

name: Plane equation
conditions: Nonzero normal (A,B,C).

name: Sphere equation
conditions: r>0 for a nondegenerate real sphere.

name: Ellipsoid standard equation
conditions: a,b,c>0; centered axis-aligned ellipsoid.

name: Shoelace area
conditions: Simple polygon; vertices in boundary order, last returns to first.

name: Midpoint of two points
conditions: Two points in Cartesian coordinates.

name: Inclination relation
conditions: Nonvertical line; angle θ from positive x axis.

name: Slope-intercept equation
conditions: Nonvertical straight line.

name: Two-point form
conditions: Both coordinate differences nonzero for this divided form.

name: General circle form
conditions: Real circle when (D²+E²)/4−F>0.

name: Vertical parabola
conditions: p≠0; vertex (h,k), focus (h,k+p).

name: Axis-aligned ellipse
conditions: a,b>0; a is horizontal semiaxis in this displayed form.

name: Horizontal hyperbola asymptotes
conditions: Hyperbola (x−h)²/a²−(y−k)²/b²=1.

name: Rotated coordinate axes
conditions: Same origin; the new coordinate axes rotated counterclockwise by θ.

name: Cartesian to polar
conditions: Use atan2(y,x) for correct quadrant; tan expression needs x≠0.

name: Vector norm
conditions: Cartesian orthonormal coordinates; omit z for 2D.

name: Cross product components
conditions: Three-dimensional right-handed Cartesian basis.

name: 3D midpoint
conditions: Same 3D orthonormal frame for both endpoints.

name: Point-normal plane
conditions: Plane through r₀ with nonzero normal n.

name: Expanded sphere equation
conditions: Completing squares must give positive radius squared.

name: Elliptic paraboloid
conditions: a,b>0; opens toward positive z.

name: Triangle determinant area
conditions: Any three plane vertices; collinear case gives zero area.
